label: ercot33 offer wall
definition: (PROBE, rejected — keeper stays ercot32) ercot33 offer-wall probe: measured peak-band quantile ladder, p50-clamped (derive_dam_offer_hrmults --peak-ladder; 60d DAM disclosure 2023-2025; capacity-weighted p10/p30/p50/p70/p90 of per-resource top-of-curve mult incl near-cap bids, rungs clamped from below at the class p50, top rung HCAP-clamped). Single delta vs the ercot32 keeper: the measured upper peak-band dispersion (the always-posted scarcity wall) is represented instead of collapsed to the median; every other flag byte-identical (measured GTC limits present, clean partitions regenerated from the NP6-86 archives this session). Attribution: docs/FINDING-ercot-priceshape-2026-07.md. Verdict: 2023 C3a flips to PASS (-2.9%), C8 forced-energy flips to PASS, >$500 deep tail 75/104; but the static wall over-withholds mild years (2025 C3a flips FAIL +7.7%) and the P0->P1 startup-amortization CT<->ST coupling moves ~8 TWh of mid-merit energy off the CAMPD-measured allocation (CT 10.4 vs ~6.4, ST 6.3 vs ~16.8 TWh 2023) -> C1/C2/C5c worsen.
